explanation: Heavy body (m=20) falling onto light body (m=0.2) trapped on thin wall (h=0.1) squeezes the light body through: contact solver's impulse plus positional correction with large mass ratio pushes the small body from y=2.3 (on wall top) to y=1.79 below the wall in one dt=1/30 step, crossing the wall box interior without registering a wall contact, hence no_tunneling.
